note: Support-art pilot (2026-09-05): seven era frontispieces for the encyclopedia's story parts. One slot per era, wide cinematic landscape or tableau, no creatures (the silhouette track owns creatures), no text, no mechanical analogies. Style clause first per the log's finding that nouns are taken literally. Eras and definitions from docs/encyclopedia/chronicle.json eras[]; imagery beats from docs/encyclopedia/tour.json.

slots.prompt: painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. A field of broken rock fragments in deep space fills the whole frame: thousands of jagged grey and black boulders and shards with sharp cracked edges, drifting in a wide loose band that curves across the picture from the left edge to the right edge, the band thick with rubble and dust and never a smooth flat ring. In a gap near the centre of the band hangs one small round intact planet, smooth grey stone, no larger than a coin against the wide frame, alone and unbroken among the wreckage. Far off in the upper right, one small dim warm point of light is the only star. Everything else is near-black space and faint grey dust.

painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. Rows of tall spacecraft hulls stand upright and still on a flat paved landing field, each hull a long dark grey cylinder with a rounded nose cone pointing straight up, a set of triangular tail fins splayed out at the bottom, and three thin metal support struts holding it upright like legs, the fins and struts resting cold and dark on the pavement with the ground beneath every hull in plain shadow. Rings of small square windows run around each hull in bands and horizontal panel seams mark the hull plating. The hulls stand far taller than any building, in straight orderly rows like a forest of standing rockets. Behind them, long low blocks of dark slate stone with flat roofs and smooth blank walls stretch to the horizon, plain storage bunkers with no windows, each block shorter than the hulls in front of it. A pale pale sky sits above the whole scene. One small lit beacon lamp on a short pole stands at the edge of the field in the foreground. A new frontier just claimed, vast scale, orderly rows of upright hulls and stone dwarfing any single figure.

painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. A vast empty dormitory hall seen straight down its centre line: two long rows of identical empty beds, each a low rectangular bed with a flat pale mattress and one small pillow, standing on the stone floor on both sides of a wide central aisle, hundreds of beds receding to a far archway, all bare, made up and unslept in. Above them a high vaulted ceiling of slate stone. The archway at the far end is completely filled by the face of one enormous round machine: a great dark metal disc of riveted plates with a thick raised outer rim and a small dark hub at its centre, its plate seams and rim glowing cold pale blue, the disc so large it touches both sides of the arch. The walls on either side of the archway are plain bare slate, empty from floor to vault. Slate walls, near-black shadows, one small lamp hanging high in the hall giving a low warm light.

painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. A wide cinematic view of an industrial world at full production: dozens of towering foundry stacks and refinery spires across a volcanic plain, a grey overcast sky above, slate-grey ground below, the stacks themselves black, columns of smoke and steam rising into the overcast, rivers of molten rock glowing red and gold cutting between the structures. Furious energy, wealth being torn out of the ground, a boomtown skyline of black and slate lit only by the molten channels.

painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. A tall thin dark grey mast stands upright in the middle of a mountain valley at night, and from the very tip of the mast three or four taut straight glowing white lines stretch straight up into the sky, each line as bright and continuous as a lit wire, running unbroken from the mast's tip up into the belly of a storm cloud directly overhead, where the lines vanish into the cloud; these glowing lines are steady and unbroken, not jagged, and are the brightest, most eye-catching part of the whole picture, brighter than anything else in the frame. Above and around the mast, separate jagged white lightning bolts branch down from a mass of grey and black storm clouds and strike the jagged black mountain peaks ringing the valley, distinct from the steady glowing lines at the mast. Tense hush before a change, a single watchful structure under an enormous natural power, uneasy calm.

painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. A wide cinematic view of a dark world under a raging orbital battle: jagged black spires rising from a barren plain into a starless sky, streaks of weapon fire and the flares of distant explosions lighting the clouds above, one massive fleet silhouette burning as it falls toward the horizon. Cold, hostile, apocalyptic scale, the last stand of a dying war lit only by destruction.

painterly concept art, high contrast, single light source, muted palette. A flat round disc of polished burnished bronze metal is set into a stone floor at the center of the frame, its edge a clean hard circle on bare grey paving. Tiered stone galleries in near-black and slate rise on all sides around the circle, seat after empty seat, empty of any crowd, dark and unlit, with plain stone stair aisles between them. Above the highest tier a smooth featureless wall of dark slate rises bare and unbroken to the top edge of the picture, with nothing hanging from it and nothing mounted on it. No sky is visible; nothing stands on or beside the disc. Ceremonial, watchful, a fragile order held together by spectacle and one ruler's will.
